scene: Delicate oiled paper umbrellas spin slowly, revealing intricate constellation maps painted inside.
picture: Flat side view of the dock pavilion. Far left, the grandfather pushes his bicycle beside hanging painted parasols. Left, a celestial umbrella spins gently on a cord. Centre, drying painted fans rest on racks. Right, an artisan in an owl mask paints. Far right, mossy stone steps rise upwards.
shown: a large celestial chart umbrella hanging low and spinning gently, left
a cloaked umbrella artisan sitting on a low bamboo stool, right
mossy stone steps leading up to an arched canal bridge, far right

variants.scene: Starry umbrellas dry quietly by the canal, smelling of fresh lacquer and paper.
A quiet craftsman paints glowing parasols as you think about finding {quest}.
